About Us

Modern Dentistry
With Human Touch

Since 2018, Niva Dental has been Ahmedabad's trusted destination for comprehensive dental care. Located in Bhuyangdev, Sola, we combine cutting-edge technology with a warm, patient-first philosophy that makes even the most anxious patients feel at ease.

Our dedicated team specialises in preventive, restorative and cosmetic dentistry — delivering outcomes that are as beautiful as they are long-lasting.

Meet The Expert

14 Years of
Clinical Mastery

Our lead dentist brings over 14 years of dedicated clinical experience to every patient interaction. With advanced specialisation in implantology, gum surgery and cosmetic dentistry, each treatment is executed with surgical precision and genuine compassion.

  • Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) — Accredited Indian University
  • Post-Graduate Specialisation in Implantology & Periodontics
  • Certified in Advanced Cosmetic & Aesthetic Dentistry
  • Regular participant in national & international dental conferences
  • Member of the Indian Dental Association (IDA)
  • Proficient in latest digital dentistry technologies

Why Niva Dental

Your Comfort.
Our Commitment.

We go beyond treating teeth — we build lasting relationships with every patient who walks through our door.

  • Digital X-Rays & Modern Technology

    90% less radiation than traditional X-rays with clearer, instant digital imaging for precise diagnosis.

  • Painless Injection Technique

    Advanced anaesthesia techniques ensure virtually pain-free dental procedures for every patient.

  • Dedicated Surgical Centre

    Separate sterile surgical suite for implants, extractions and gum surgeries with hospital-grade protocols.

  • Flexible Payment Options

    We believe quality dental care should be accessible to all.

  • Online Appointment Booking

    WhatsApp and phone booking available. Minimal wait times and appointment reminders for your convenience.
